subject: english
stem: What happens next in this passage after “Many residents found it useful: parents with children, older people, delivery workers, and tourists.”?
options: The project showed that efficiency must include people outside cars.
The project showed that good design listens to behavior.
The project showed that public service needs both speed and judgment.
The project showed that dignity often depends on basic facilities.

optionRationales.reason: 本文沒有陳述「The project showed that efficiency must include people outside cars.」；這個選項混入另一個情境的資訊。
本文沒有陳述「The project showed that good design listens to behavior.」；這個選項混入另一個情境的資訊。
本文沒有陳述「The project showed that public service needs both speed and judgment.」；這個選項混入另一個情境的資訊。
本文可直接核對「Many residents found it useful: parents with children, older people, delivery workers, and tourists. The project showed that dignity often depends on…」，所以這個選項符合完整語境。

independentReviews.evidence: 獨立覆核 A：在鎖定文章中定位「Many residents found it useful: parents with children, older people, delivery workers, and tourists. The project showed that dignity often depends on basic facilities.」，答案為「The project showed that dignity often depends on basic facilities.」。
獨立覆核 B：逐項回查文章，只有「The project showed that dignity often depends on basic facilities.」有同篇證據，三個干擾項均來自不同情境。
